rows.text: ...Whoa, looks like the battle here was intense...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The master diviner must have launched the campaign while we were delayed in the Artisanship Commission.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Time is of the essence. The most important task for the Xianzhou Luofu is suppressing the Stellaron.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: General Jing Yuan tasked the master diviner with commanding the Cloud Knights — he would've known she'd act on the results of her divination.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Indeed. Since General Jing Yuan tasked the master diviner with commanding the Cloud Knights, he must've known she'd act on the results of her divination.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Thank goodness the general didn't make us go with the Knights... Fighting is totally different from adventuring. All these people... I—It's tough to bear.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm afraid this is nothing, benefactor...
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Centuries ago, an Emanator of Abundance besieged the Luofu with the aim of taking the Ambrosial Arbor. They destroyed half our delves and killed most of the Cloud Knights.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: The crucible gradually stops shaking, and the smoke slowly ceases to pour out.
For long-life species, such events are more like yesterday's memories than ancient history. This awful spectacle is child's play in comparison.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Hey, is that supposed to make us feel better!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's hard to tell if the master diviner won or lost here.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I think so too! I can't see many Cloud Knights — the Xianzhou must have fought well!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, whose side are you on!? I can't see many Cloud Knights — the Xianzhou must have fought well!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...A draw? This isn't a tournament, y'know! I can't see many Cloud Knights — the Xianzhou must have fought well!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Not necessarily. There'd usually be a base with supporting forces set up after a successful engagement, but we don't see any of that.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Let's look around and see if we can find some clues.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Be careful, [Trailblazer]. Those monsters are pretty tough...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Look, there's someone over there!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Here! There are still survivors here...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmm? You're not the Knights... What is your purpose here? It's dangerous.
rows.speaker: Woman in Healer Dress

rows.text: We're reinforcements sent by the general. Where's everyone else?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Tsk, resorting to short-life species as reinforcements... Hehe, Jing Yuan is truly running out of options.
rows.speaker: Woman in Healer Dress

rows.text: Run! She's... a Disciple of Sanctus Medicus!
rows.speaker: Dying Cloud Knight

rows.text: Silence. If my healing worked, you'll become one of us...
rows.speaker: Woman in Healer Dress

rows.text: ...and then it's not just me they'll be running from.
rows.speaker: Woman in Healer Dress

rows.text: H—Hold on! We'll find someone to help...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't waste your time. They've "converted" me. I don't have much longer...
rows.speaker: Dying Cloud Knight

rows.text: Go... The master diviner's troops are ahead...
rows.speaker: Dying Cloud Knight

rows.text: ...Let's go.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: He stops talking. It could be because he is exhausted, or he's waiting for you to leave him be.
The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus were in hiding for so long... now they finally show their face. Did the master diviner fail to foresee this...?
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Be careful, benefactors. The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus worship Yaoshi the Plagues Author — the greatest enemy of the Xianzhou.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: The Alliance has been trying to root out their secret organization for millennia — it's no coincidence that they've chosen this moment to reveal themselves.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Reignbow's blessing... You're not Disciples of Sanctus Medicus...
rows.speaker: Injured Cloud Knight

rows.text: Stop moving around! Let's see if there's a way to help you recover faster.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come on, take this. It'll help with your injuries.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Th—Thank you, all of you. I feel much better now.
rows.speaker: Recovered Cloud Knight

rows.text: Thank goodness you're here... The garrison is up ahead, are you heading there now? I'll wait there for you.
rows.speaker: Recovered Cloud Knight

rows.text: Don't we have anything to help her?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Uhh, you wait here. I'm gonna get your comrades to help you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Just leave me...
rows.speaker: Injured Cloud Knight

rows.text: Who goes there? Show yourselves!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Guard

rows.text: Wait, it's you...! Quickly, in here! It's dangerous outside.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Guard

rows.text: There is a ghastly paleness in the face of this resident Cloud Knight. As you approach him, he nods his head in salute.
You recognize us?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Are you not the general's guests? The master diviner prophesied your arrival — we were ordered to wait for you under any circumstances.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Guard

rows.text: Fu Xuan was here?
Wait for us?

Yes. The master diviner ordered us to remain stationed here and went to scout ahead. They're saying the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus have returned — they haven't been seen for an age... The troops are anxious.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Guard

rows.text: They became mara-struck...
Those monsters...
There's a wounded warrior that didn't make it back to his unit...
It's good that you're here — the master diviner said the Knights weren't to move out until you arrived.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Guard

rows.text: Please wait in the camp — we'll decide on our next steps once the master diviner returns.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Guard

rows.text: That the Cloud Knights received orders not to advance is a bad sign. The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus... I've heard the name before. If memory serves, they're an underground sect of the Abundance that's said to have lain dormant within the Xianzhou, plotting to overthrow the Alliance...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The Stellaron has certainly caused Abundance-like abnormalities — is that what motivated the Disciples to come out of the shadows? No. The Knight's main force remains intact... Something must have happened — something we're not aware of. The master diviner isn't here — let's head into camp and see what we can learn from the troops here.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Good idea, why don't you take a look around, benefactors? My feet need a rest.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Have you talked with these Disciples, benefactor? What do you make of them?
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: A Cloud Knight is standing next to the captive. He steps aside after you explain your identity and show him the general's order.
You want to ask questions? Fine, but I must be present the whole way through. This part needs to be recorded as testimony.
rows.speaker: Alarmed Cloud Knight

rows.text: ...Finally someone to talk to. These Cloud Knights are so serious, so boring, hehe...
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: About Stellarons...
About the Ambrosial Arbor...
What did you do to these Cloud Knights?
I don't have any more questions.
That shining seed? Haha, I've seen it, so beautiful. If you gaze into it, there's a voice inside that speaks to you...
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: [Trailblazer]... do you still remember Cocolia?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Not yet...
The master said we could inject new life into the Ambrosial Arbor with it. Hehe, I didn't believe it at first.
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: We tried many methods, spending multiple lifetimes of short-life species, yet the Arbor showed no signs of resurrection.
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: But look upon it now, hehe — "only the power of an Aeon can recreate the miracle." Yes, yes, the mighty Sanctus Medicus! The Abundance!
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: So you witnessed it too? The Ambrosial Arbor's resurrection, hehe... Magnificent!
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: In the {RUBY_B#Theophany Era}befall era{RUBY_E#}, so far in the past that even long-life species cannot recall, Sanctus Medicus the Abundance gifted the Ambrosial Arbor to the Xianzhou Luofu. With that sacred tree, humanity realized many miracles: The fallow earth, the western soapberry, the altered flesh...
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: But that Devilish Archer ruined everything! They twisted right and wrong and erased Sanctus Medicus's achievements... But soon... soon we will return to the glory of the {RUBY_B#Theophany Era}befall era{RUBY_E#}!
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: You've seen the fantastic creatures that fought with us? They are only minor gifts of the Ambrosial Arbor...
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: Shut it, rambling rodent. The Cloud Knights will root all of you out soon.
rows.speaker: Alarmed Cloud Knight

rows.text: What did we do? We cured our kin! Hehe, it must hurt to be trapped in such weak flesh and blood...
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: You scum... If the order allowed I would cut you down now.
rows.speaker: Alarmed Cloud Knight

rows.text: Oh, you don't understand... a short-life species couldn't understand. Mara-struck? Bah! It's a second life gifted by Sanctus Medicus! To eliminate the self! To achieve transcendence! A life of true freedom!
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: I see a desire for power in your eyes. This life is too short for you, isn't it? Hehe, I can... I can help you...
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: Don't listen, his words are poison.
rows.speaker: Alarmed Cloud Knight

rows.text: We're just having fun, sir, hehe... Without the blessing of the Abundance, you short-life species would never be able to endure the transformation.
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: Why would they betray the Luofu... I don't understand.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: It was so close... so close...!
rows.speaker: Shocked Cloud Knight

rows.text: Ready.
Not yet...
Even seasoned soldiers — soldiers of three centuries were turned into... twisted beings! I was almost... almost...
rows.speaker: Shocked Cloud Knight

rows.text: The Cloud Knights undergo such thorough training. How could they lose control like this?
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Foxian

rows.text: It's one thing for humans to be stricken with mara. But foxians and Vidyadhara...?
rows.speaker: Sky-Faring Commission Foxian

rows.text: Disciples of Sanctus Medicus... who would have thought our enemies would turn out to be the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus...
rows.speaker: Mumbling Cloud Knight

rows.text: *sigh* The master diviner must have kept it quiet to avoid alerting them.
rows.speaker: Mumbling Cloud Knight

rows.text: But this is different from all our previous battles! Captain, even our own comrades may become our enemies this time...
rows.speaker: Nervous Cloud Knight

rows.text: Every Cloud Knight knows what they must do if their comrades become mara-struck. Don't forget your training.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Captain

rows.text: B—But this shouldn't be happening! We're still so young — we're not old enough to be stricken with mara yet...
rows.speaker: Nervous Cloud Knight

rows.text: There are records of such a phenomenon in the Cloud Knights Martial Doctrine. Those who come into contact with the Plagues Author become mara-struck instantly... I never thought the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus were real, or so close to us.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Captain

rows.text: I—I don't know how many more of our soldiers will...
rows.speaker: Nervous Cloud Knight

rows.text: I... saw it... I saw myself become thunder... become a storm...
rows.speaker: Deranged Disciple

rows.text: That scent in the elixir crucible... I could smell the future...
rows.speaker: Deranged Disciple

rows.text: Mere flesh will not trap me... I am the Ebon Deer. I see the leaves and branches covering the sky. I will change again...
rows.speaker: Deranged Disciple

rows.text: We captured a few devils from the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. Some of them are already mad, and this one is the maddest.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Guarding Prisoners

rows.text: Command Talisman required for operation...
rows.speaker: Aurumaton Guard

rows.text: What does it mean?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We probably need to present it with a command for it to act.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Have you talked with these Disciples, benefactor? What do you make of them?
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: What a pity. I would've liked to observe it for a while longer...
rows.speaker: Tingyun (?)

rows.text: Since you received the gift of Abundance, surely you can withstand the blessing of Destruction as well?
rows.speaker: Tingyun (?)

rows.text: They're mad...
Head to Scalegorge Waterscape.
Removing the helmet, you look straight into the face of the fallen Cloud Knight.

An expression of agony is frozen on the face of this Xianzhou man of indiscernible age. You find a cluster of mutated branches at the temples of his hair — he seems to have been subjected to purgatory-like torture before his death.
I feel sorry for them...
I can understand their desire for knowledge...
True. But in the eyes of the Denizens of Abundance...
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: ...ignoring the true nature of long-life species, suppressing the inner mara, maintaining the facade of mortal society... it's a child's game. Another breed of madness, perhaps.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: They brought this upon themselves. The Xianzhou Alliance forbids anyone from accessing forbidden knowledge regarding immortality.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: They should have thought about whether they were capable of paying the price when seeking the power of an Aeon.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Shh, that's a brave thing to say out in the open... If the Cloud Knights hear you, they won't think twice.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Hehe, it strikes me that you'd use any means to achieve your goal, benefactor.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Xianzhou natives are more afraid of immortality than they are of the days coming to an end.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: They received eternal life as they had desired, but are doomed to a fate more terrifying than death. The Abundance played a cruel trick on them.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Forgive me for being brief — warfare is a dangerous business. There's no time for idle chat.
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: How's the situation?

We took over this place a few hours ago under the master diviner's command. It was only afterwards that we learned our enemies were none other than the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus — those who worship the {RUBY_B#Yaoshi}Plagues Author{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: Everything was going as planned. The sorcerers of the Disciples and the fantastic creatures they commanded were no match for us.
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: The Cloud Knights are guarding a prisoner who is murmuring to himself.
...Then, after a while, our comrades suddenly started to slaughter one another...
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: Curse it! What Sanctus Medicus sorcery did they use on us!?
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: Yes, among the Sanctus Medicus monsters... there were our comrades.
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: Thanks for your intel. I'll dispatch someone immediately.
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: The alchemist's eyes were unfocused, darting back and forth, as if he were looking at the two diverging ends of a path.
A painful moan amidst the ravaged battlefield draws your attention.

The greatest fear of the Xianzhou people is succumbing to our mara-struck form around others. To do so means that we have given up on being human, lost to the abomination sleeping in our immortal blood... and violated the Reignbow's admonishments.
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: What the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus did are despicable acts that every Alliance resident detests!
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: (provides medical attention)
(temporarily giving up)
...I swear to the Arbiter that I will avenge my comrades.
rows.speaker: On-Duty Cloud Knight

rows.text: When the Master Diviner gets back, we might be in for tough times... It's making me a little nervous.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], are you ready?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Master diviner! You're back!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Guard

rows.text: You fumble through your bag to find medicine for her wounds and administer it one drop at a time.
For a moment you are worried that medicine made for ordinary humans might not work on long-life species.
The Cloud Knight propped herself up so she could stand.
I have kept you waiting, but the deceit of the Disciples is laid bare to me now.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Hmph, I was merely being courteous — according to my divination you've hardly been here long.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The conflict is difficult, master diviner, but you have led your forces from the front lines and beyond in pursuit of the enemy. Admirable work.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Hardly! A diviner must acquire first-hand knowledge in order to calculate the future. Collecting intelligence in this way assists me in achieving the right answer...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Wait... what's all this about a difficult conflict? The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus have been scheming for a long time, but our army is in no way inferior. How can things be so difficult?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Sharp as always.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: *sigh* I knew we'd spent too long around the master diviner — now we're predicting the future...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It would seem you came prepared.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: *sigh* The first time we met Madam Yukong she said something like: "This is a Xianzhou affair and there's no need for the Express to get involved..."
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...and now here we are running around doing everything. Even the IPC takes it easier on us.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Lemme guess, what are we up to this time? Could it be... heading to the front lines? Leading the Cloud Knight charge?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well try this on for size — nope! I can't stand anymore of this fighting, so there!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: *sigh* Who said you'd be heading to the battlefield...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: W—We're not?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Jing Yuan's orders. He said that the value of unexpected guests lies in the unexpected. The Cloud Knights' assault was to demonstrate our power to the enemy head-on... now it is time for the unexpected.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Please, come with me.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: After receiving the Ambrosial Arbor, the Alchemy Commission was once the Luofu's most vital commission.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: After all, it was they who changed the Xianzhou natives into long-life species... They also developed many incredible technologies from the tree itself.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: But in the end, the alchemists grew discontented and began to obsess over the manipulation of life. Research into the Arbor poisoned their minds... the more they pursued it, the more they longed for it.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: "Morning bells chime in a dream, evening mist gathers around me"...Do you see that?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: What huge elixir crucibles. There's still smoke coming out of them.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: This is where the alchemists practiced the way of immortality in ancient times. They erected elixir crucibles here to absorb the power of the Arbor, turning fantasy into reality. Since the smoke from the crucibles never ceases, this place was named Evemist Mansion.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: An elegant name, but as far as the art of war is concerned, it's a deathtrap. As long as the crucibles are lit and the smoke continues to linger, we cannot get any closer.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: This is why the Cloud Knights lost control and became mara-struck?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Indeed. The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus infused the smoke that permeates this delve with medicinal pellets that elicit mara.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Unless the Cloud Knights were able to march with their breath held, they would be doomed to fall into disarray. Moreover, no one could know whether their comrade was about to be stricken with mara. Is there anything better than fear for destroying the morale of an army?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The Cloud Knights first assault was just a cover. You're using the main army to attract the enemy's attention, while we douse the elixir crucibles and stop the smoke.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus renounced their century of secrecy and chose to reveal themselves, meaning they feel confident of victory... but no matter how well-prepared they may be, their focus has always been the Cloud Knights. They are completely unaware of your existence and capacity, and in short — cannot be prepared against you.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Indeed. This demonic vapor is a weapon targeted against the Cloud Knights.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The Ambrosial Arbor is taboo for the Luofu, and the Xianzhou Alliance has always been fiercely independent. The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus could never have guessed that the general would seek outside help — they won't be prepared against short-life species.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: You misunderstand the nature of the mara-struck condition — it is not a curse unique to humankind. foxians don't usually succumb to it because their lifespan is not eternal, yet they are still a long-life species. The Vidyadhara rely on molting to discard the old world. All long-life species are equal in the face of mara...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: However, the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus could never have guessed that the general would seek outside help — they won't be prepared against short-life species.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Is this what General Jing Yuan meant by unexpected guests?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I wouldn't hazard a guess. All I can say is that the predictions of the Stellaron Hunters were more accurate than mine. The future that Kafka seeks is becoming reality... one step at a time.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I do not wish to be their puppet, either. In any case, we do not walk alone and unhindered on our paths. Our choices define us and influence others.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Rather, only this way leads to the known best result. If we can afford to choose, then none would choose to leap off a cliff.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Besides, this is not my decision alone...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The duty of the master diviner is to bring luck and avoid misfortune. I don't want my choice to plunge the Luofu into a terrible future.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: To return to the matter at hand, only you can douse the elixir crucibles without being harmed by them. What say you?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Fine. I didn't hear a "please," but seeing as we do kinda have superpowers around here... [Trailblazer], Mr. Yang, what do you think?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I will come at once when the smoke dissipates — you won't be left to fend for yourselves.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: *coughing* What? It's not too late to practice holding my breath...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: You seem quite alright...
Is that smoke really safe though?
How large are the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus's forces?
The crucible starts to shake, and smoke emits out of the cold elixir crucible.
I'll leave you to it.
Look out! Enemies incoming!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The talismans on the elixir cauldron are dark and inactive. The elixir crucible lies silent.
Curiously, you put your hand on an ancient engraving. The crucible begins to shake and smoke rises up towards the sky.
We're still far from the elixir crucibles. I'm no healer, but I do know that dosage is important in the application of poisons...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Agh...
Don't move. Let me have a look...

Sorry, I didn't want to stop the general's distinguished guests, but just to warn you, there have been some dangerous sightings ahead. For your own safety, please stay in the areas guarded by the Cloud Knights.
rows.speaker: Alarmed Cloud Knight

rows.text: Hmph, even so... Okay I admit it — I'm terrified! I'm still young! I don't wanna become mara-struck so soon!
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Then you'd better return to the home front.
But if your condition worsens...

Out of the question! Jing Yuan gave me authority over the Cloud Knights. If I can't even stand on the front lines, then how can I succeed him as general? *cough* How can I win the hearts of the people!?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: My fortune is fluctuating between the marsh and heaven trigrams — I can avert disaster by being decisive. So stop talking to me and distracting me!
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I'll focus on keeping my sanity. The rest is up to you.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Do you not trust me?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: *coughing* ...If I told you I wasn't certain, would you turn back on the spot?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: You don't have the slightest clue, do you?
Do a divination.
Nonsense! I'm very certain! One-hundred percent!
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: No need. Aside from divinations and calculations, my instincts are accurate too!
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: ...Though I'm sure a little reassurance wouldn't hurt. You don't know what being mara-struck actually means, do you?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The healers believe that the mara-struck condition is related to memories. Unsurprisingly, long-life species have long lifespans, but there is a limit to the brain's capacity.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: After centuries and millennia, a long-life species' emotional threshold becomes higher and higher. Simultaneously, their memories fade and become dull under the erosion of time, leaving behind only the most extreme and vivid recollections, which are almost guaranteed to be memories full of anguish and regret...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Do you understand now? The fate of all long-life species is to no longer feel joy and happiness, left only with hatred and regret etched into the heart. Under such extreme conditions, a person's ego starts to crumble... and that is the beginning of the mara-struck condition.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Short-life species don't need to worry about this. Feel better?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Phew, I do — I never had memories to begin with.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...No, you still don't understand. The condition isn't caused by memories, but by the emotional threshold having been... Never mind. You can regard it as a memory issue.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Only a handful of converted alchemists and healers. They can drive fantastic creatures into battle and strengthen their bodies with medicinal pellets... but they are no match for the Cloud Knights. That's why they decided to spread this demonic vapor.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: There is a gulf in strength between us, yet still they emerged into the open and rebelled. Something isn't right. They must be waiting for some shift in fortune...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I will come at once when the crucibles are doused and the smoke dissipates.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: *sigh* I feel like... even though long-life species get to live forever...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...they aren't so different from us short-life species when it comes to worries and suffering.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wait, Miss Tingyun, why are you still here!? You're too close to the crucible!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thank you for the concern, but I'm fine~ The general commanded me to stay with you — I dare not go against military orders.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Your life is more important, Miss Tingyun. Go back, we can explain to the general.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Hehe, there's really no need — I've spent my years traveling the universe! Not to mention, I'm younger and stronger than I look.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Even you benefactors have probably lived longer than me.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Seems like the smoke is getting thinner...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Not thin enough. We need to hurry.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: T—Turn it off! [Trailblazer], why did you turn it on!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Are you doing this on purpose!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yay, we did it! Can't see the smoke anymore.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: E—Excellent. I'll lead my troops to the rendezvous.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: So you succeeded in dousing the elixir cauldrons...
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: Unimportant. The inevitable is already upon us.
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: Dan Shu... it's you.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I have met you before in my capacity as chief alchemist, master diviner... You don't seem surprised.
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: Apologies. To avoid dissemination of intelligence, the general and I kept the involvement of the Disciples to ourselves.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: It is a clandestine organization that seeks to overthrow the Alliance. Before the Stellaron disaster, the Disciples had remained veiled in shadow for years. Their emergence reflects their intricate connection to this calamity.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Indeed. The general and I knew that the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus must be hiding in the Alchemy Commission. However, without evidence, we couldn't bring charges before the commissions. We had to wait for you to show yourselves...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: ...and now, your charges are many. Drawing Stellaron spirits into the Xianzhou, resurrecting the Ambrosial Arbor, striking down our people with mara... The Ten-Lords Commission will address these transgressions during your reckoning.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Crimes? If I am guilty, then all of our Xianzhou ancestors are also guilty! They were the ones who accepted the blessings of the Abundance and turned their descendants into long-life species...
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus are only walking on the road our ancestors once took. How is it a crime to seek ascendance?
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: In days of old, the roots of the Ambrosial Arbor enveloped the Xianzhou Luofu like a living creature. We controlled the stellar seas and none could stand in our way. Everyone could become a celestial and shift form at will. Divine miracles descended onto all nine Xianzhou ships. What a glorious time that was...
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: How far the Xianzhou has fallen! We consent to be commanded by the Devilish Archer, suffer continuously at the hands of the Denizens of Abundance, and the Ten-Lords Commission even forces us to give up our immortality...
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: How pitiful! I do not blame you for your ignorance — we were not born in the era when the Ambrosial Arbor first descended, nor did we witness its miracles. But now we now have an opportunity to restore the ancient laws...
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: Hmph... Forgive me for thinking you might have harbored some profound enlightment. Yours is the same old talk of those who seek power... and give up on their humanity.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Our Xianzhou ancestors fought side by side with the Arbiter, laid waste to the Arbor, and established the Ten-Lords Commission to lay down the lines between life and death... In doing so, we enshrined our future as human beings.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Celestials? There are no celestials on the Xianzhou. The "divine miracles" of the Abundance, the manipulation of life and death... Your deeds are nothing but evil!
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I have nothing to say to you, Master diviner — you have already made your decision. You have discarded power... a most foolish choice.
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: The Ambrosial Arbor's descent... will bring us undying bodies...
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: The one who gave us the Stellaron... said that...
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: Phantylia... the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus have fulfilled our promise...
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: You, Lord Ravager, must do the same... Now! Quickly!
rows.speaker: Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus

rows.text: Ah ah, little pawn, must you force me to intervene directly? I'm loath to flout my philosophy of destruction.
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Never mind. It would seem the time has come for other means of dismantling the Xianzhou from within...
rows.speaker: Tingyun

rows.text: Miss Tingyun!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: W—Wait, hold on a second — are you really saying that Miss Tingyun was a member of the Antimatter Legion all along?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: And what was that fire that came out of her? And her body — where did it go?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mr. Yang, you're smart. What happened just now!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The flame we witnessed claimed to be Lord Ravager Phantylia — a name I've heard other Nameless speak of in the past.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: She's one of seven Lord Ravagers who serve Nanook... and finds pleasure in witnessing the self-destruction of mortals. She's led countless souls down a dark and hopeless path.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...Meaning that Tingyun had long since fallen under the Lord Ravager's influence?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I don't believe so. Phantylia revels in watching a corrupted mind eating away its host from inside out, until the obliteration of both is achieved.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But there was no indication that Tingyun had been misguided or manipulated... It's possible that the Tingyun we knew wasn't her true self, but an image Phantylia devised to serve her own purposes.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You're saying that the real Tingyun is still...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm sorry March, I can't say with any certainty where the real Tingyun may be, or at what point she was replaced by the impostor. Without knowing where the body vanished to, it'll be tough to get an answer.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: At this point, it's all just conjecture and hope. But if that body belonged to the real Tingyun, it does raise the question of why Phantylia would go to such lengths to destroy any evidence of her. Wouldn't it be more in line with her destructive nature to leave Tingyun's remains behind as a display of power?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I believe this to be Phantylia's goal — to sow seeds of doubt among us and ensnare us in a malevolent trap.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's clear that the sudden resurgence of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus is all connected to the Lord Ravager. Pretending to be a Xianzhou citizen, planting a Stellaron on the Luofu — all part of her plan to bring about our self-destruction.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Phantylia is aiming for the Ambrosial Arbor! If she succeeds, the Luofu will be deprived of its roots, making its destruction all too easy. We must stop her!
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: We need to take a starskiff to Scalegorge Waterscape — the Ambrosial Arbor can be sealed from that delve.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: [Trailblazer], let's make haste.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: That impostor had the audacity to carry out her nefarious plans right under our noses... How utterly despicable.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: What worries me more is... just how many more Antimatter saboteurs are at large?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: About Tingyun...
About Scalegorge Waterscape...
Where is Jing Yuan?
(Stay here for now.)
It all happened so suddenly... but looking back, I think Mr. Yang was right. Tingyun was behaving strangely — she was fascinated with the Abundance's creations.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Since she was an Amicassador dispatched by the Sky-Faring Commission, it's evident that there must indeed be a person with her name in the Commission. We'll have to let the Cloud Knights get to the bottom of what happened to the real Tingyun.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: As for the "Tingyun" who accompanied us all that way, it's like what Mr. Yang said — her appearance was designed to sow seeds of doubt among us... we cannot allow ourselves to fall into her trap.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: It is a delve governed by the Vidyadhara — supposedly an ancient oceanic region transferred from the Vidyadhara home planet.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: After the Ambrosial Arbor was broken in two during the war, its roots were left gnarled and broken... yet it never died.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The Alliance decided to seal the Arbor within Scalegorge Waterscape, entrust it to the high elders of the Vidyadhara, and rely on the power of Long's Scions to constrain it.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: It has been so long — no one knows whether the seal remains... Even if it does, I doubt it will hinder that spectral Lord Ravager.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I've reported the current situation to the Seat of Divine Foresight.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: He made no further contact after we communicated at the Matrix of Prescience. He said he had "important matters to personally attend to."
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The situation stands on the edge of a precipice. We must trust in the general...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Why are we still here? Things will change if we tarry too long.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Time is of the essence. Let's go.
Uh, this is...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Huh? You're pretty familiar with this place.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Yep, it's the Alchemy Commission. No wonder we were getting those military broadcasts on the way over — something about the Cloud Knights gathering here, right? They're probably coming to fix the Stellaron problem.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: *sigh* It's been such a long journey, but now we're finally gonna meet some Cloud Knights! I'll be back with my unit!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I didn't lie to you, right? I told you I'd bring you somewhere safe, and I did! Though... we did take a bit of a detour...
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Before I arrived in Starskiff Haven, I had a diviner read my fortune for the journey ahead. He told me not to be concerned with the destination, but to seize my chances and travel with the current to reap the greatest harvest.
rows.speaker: Luocha

rows.text: ...Meaning?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Meaning thank you, Miss Sushang.
rows.speaker: Luocha

rows.text: Oh... okay. Well, I'm gonna go report to the nearest captain.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: You guys can hang around here, but don't run off too far — there'll be Cloud Knights coming to escort you back soon. Bye for now!
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: (The messages never get sent... I wonder what's happening with those three?)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Disciples of Sanctus Medicus?
Have you seen any outworlders?
(The Cloud Knights seem to be gathering for the Stellaron disaster... but why did Kafka want us to come here? What happened to them? And what happened to Blade?)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (I've delayed for too long. I need more information...)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Those Travelers defeated the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus... Won't that make us seem... incompetent?
rows.speaker: Mumbling Cloud Knight

rows.text: I—I need to find a way to make this report sound more... impressive.
rows.speaker: Mumbling Cloud Knight

rows.text: (Dan Heng briefly described to the captain the appearances of March 7th and the crew.)
The master must have failed to summon the protection of Sanctus Medicus — her will must have wavered.
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: Just you wait — I'll show you the blessing of Sanctus Medicus.
rows.speaker: Captured Disciple

rows.text: What's up?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: I need to go.
Nothing...
Go? Go where? The Luofu is under lockdown — the Cloud Knights' operation isn't over yet.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Relax. When the fight is over, I'll personally escort you and Mr. Luocha home~
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Don't worry. Once the fight is over, I'll personally escort you and Mr. Luocha home~
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: You haven't been back home for a long time, have you Master Dan Heng?
rows.speaker: Luocha

rows.text: (Lie) This isn't my home.
How did you know...
Ah... is that so? Apologies.
rows.speaker: Luocha

rows.text: As home draws nearer, so our feelings grow stronger. I can see it in your eyes.
rows.speaker: Luocha

rows.text: Do you want to leave? Then do it now.
rows.speaker: Luocha

rows.text: The Cloud Knights will soon check our identities. I have somewhere else to be — I've tarried here too long.
rows.speaker: Luocha

rows.text: ...Where are you going?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm a traveling merchant. I have one more deal to see through.
rows.speaker: Luocha

rows.text: The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus started a rebellion in the Alchemy Commission — the Cloud Knights have the area locked down. It's not safe, please remain here for now.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Captain

rows.text: We will send someone to escort you back once the operation is over.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Captain

rows.text: Lunatics — all of them. You saw the Ambrosial Arbor, I assume? I heard that's the work of those sorcerers. Still, I can't say too much — military secrets.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Captain

rows.text: (The Arbor's resurrection is connected to the Disciples' rebellion... I've heard those names before, but when?)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (How did [Trailblazer] and the others get drawn into all this...?)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You must be talking about the general's guests. Are they your friends?
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Captain

rows.text: What a coincidence — they left with the master diviner not long ago. It's all thanks to their courageous work that the Knights don't have to worry about the poison in Evemist Mansion.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Captain

rows.text: I received the good news from the front lines. They'll probably be back soon.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Captain

rows.text: Thanks. That's all I wanted to know.
Strange, you seem oddly familiar to me... Never mind, too many misfortunes recently — I can hardly think straight.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Captain

rows.text: What a huge cauldron.
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: This aureate cauldron is driven by the cloudhymn magic of our people — the Vidyadhara. It drinks the water of the ancient sea like a whale swallows the tide, and refines it into medicinal pellets...
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: All the elixir crucibles that the Vidyadhara helped to construct contain cloudhymn magic. You should take this chance to learn more, young master...
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: Huh? But I don't need any sort of device to help me command water, what more is there to learn?
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: You are indeed the chosen one, with endless potential... yet cloudhymn magic is just the beginning.
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: A Vidyadhara Mirage Echo... Have these shadows of the past yet to disperse?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: These memories...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No. They have nothing to do with me anymore.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: They say that you are Long's power incarnate. Is that true?
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: Hmph...
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: Aargh... Long...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I was exiled from the Xianzhou. I am no longer one of the Scions of Permanence.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A little while ago...
I doubt I will be here to see you take charge...
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: No need to feel aggrieved. Vidyadhara go through cycles of life and death, existing forever in this world.
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: By the time you are the high elder, my hatching rebirth will be complete and I will be a child once again. Please take care of me.
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: This surging power... It's you... You've returned, High Elder.
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: Something terrible is happening in Scalegorge Waterscape. Please don't go any further... Your enemies... Your enemies are waiting for you.
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: I'm sorry, I cannot linger here. My friends have left — I must find them.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You didn't heed us then, and won't heed us now... as headstrong as you always were.
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: It seems you already made your decision. There is a vessel bound for Scalegorge Waterscape located ahead.
rows.speaker: Past Echo

rows.text: He's here.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Mm, right on time.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: ...That feeling, Kafka — it's welling up within me. That feeling! I—It's...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Don't resist. Let the mara strike you...
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: You're here.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: *laughing in madness* It's time to pay the price! It's time!!!
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: You think changing form will help you escape!? Escape...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I have told you and that woman many times... I am Dan Heng.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I have nothing to do with your past.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng... You think another name and face can blot out the sin of your past? You... You didn't even experience death...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I will force this suffering upon you, "Dan Heng." You will know the pain of death!
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Hmph, not on my watch.
You're not murdering anyone today, fugitive. You're coming with me.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Jing Yuan's lapdog... Did the general not teach you to choose your battles wisely...?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Hey, move back. Things are about to... Huh?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: You... you look so familiar...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Look out!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: All of you, listen to me — stop.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Well, Bladie? Are you satisfied?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Hmph.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...What did you do?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm just clearing the stage for the grand entrance — can't have you three misbehaving in front of the Luofu's hotshot general.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Haha.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Jing Yuan...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: General!
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Many years have passed since the two of you departed the Xianzhou, and yet the circumstances of your return appear to be equally unhappy. If you still thought of me as a friend, you should've forewarned me.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: My task is complete.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Mm, that it is.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Thank you for assisting the Xianzhou in this small matter. Take this person away — I will pretend I didn't see anything this time.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: General!? I...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Now is not the time.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: It has been a long time... old friend.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I'm not him.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Mm... I'm sorry.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: You cannot leave yet — your Astral Express friends are waiting for you in Scalegorge Waterscape. Shall we go and see them together?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Lunarescent Depths — a realm of singular beauty. Scalegorge Waterscape is the same as when I last laid eyes on it... and here we stand so different from one another. The flesh of long-life species may be immortal, but the constant of heaven and earth eludes them.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: You know the Vidyadhara hatching rebirth cycle, general. The waters of the ancient sea have cleansed Dan Feng of his past sin. The person that once stood here alongside you is no more.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I am Dan Heng. Whether Dan Feng was hero or villain has nothing to do with me. I bore his punishment, accepted my eternal banishment without complaint... but do not let his shadow cloud your estimation of me, general.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: *sigh* Raising old nets only darkens the water — an exercise in unhappiness. Perhaps it is your visage, the horns on your head, or the unmistakable air of the high elder that makes the separation nigh impossible for me.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...I already told you—
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You did... but to what effect? If words alone were enough to change the heart, this world would be without quarrel. If you wish to rid me of the illusion of Dan Feng, you must do something for me.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Before I can let Dan Feng die and revoke your banishment edict, I need him to do me one final favor. I can guarantee you that when it is done, you will no longer walk in anyone's shadow aboard the Luofu.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I may not be capable of the things that Dan Feng was capable of.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You must do it, or my promise will count for naught. If you wish to blame someone, blame your previous incarnation. Had he not committed that terrible sin — had the power of dragon transmutation been passed on intact — I would have no need to compel you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: It is as I said: Here we stand so different from one another. Dan Feng is no more — now there is only Dan Heng. But I...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I am the general of the Luofu. There are things that I wish I did not have to do, and yet I must.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Haha, let us talk of happier tidings. The friends you made on the Express are here. Do you wish to see them?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: [Trailblazer], March, Mr. Yang... You brought them here!?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yes, they are waiting in the Dragonvista Rain Hall.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Go, your friends are waiting for you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I have been keeping careful watch against the Abominations of Abundance, the Stellaron Hunters, and the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus... but I never anticipated the Antimatter Legion.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The Hunt is far from over, yet all the while we find ourselves at war with other evil spirits... Hmph, from this battle onward, the Alliance must fight the Legion to our dying breath, even if it means the end of the Luofu.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Our intelligence tells us that the Legion are a mad and destructive war machine, yet they never took up arms against the Alliance. The armies of the Seven Ravagers all have their own means of destruction — they are not to be taken lightly.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Lord Ravager Phantylia favors internal collapse, which is why she masterminded the Stellaron crisis and urged the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus out of the shadows. Now that her plot has been laid bare she has no choice but to retreat... and yet that hardly suits her philosophy of destruction. There must be something more...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Her hatching rebirth is complete... she left me all alone.
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: Still, I wait for the day of my rebirth... endless waiting...
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: Do you know something? When Dan Feng committed his great crime, the Ten-Lords Commission advocated strongly for him to be destroyed. The Vidyadhara, on the other hand, were split evenly in their favor and disfavor of the motion. Haha, the dragon transmutation inheritance was not intact, after all. The senior Vidyadhara hated you, yet did not dare to kill you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The Vidyadhara were under great pressure. In order to placate the Ten-Lords and Sky-Faring Commissions, they performed an exuviation charm on Dan Feng against his will. Still, they ensured that the charm contained a flaw, thinking that this would fool the Ten-Lords Commission. Hmph, the senior Vidyadhara were sure of their scheme, but you cannot hide fire with paper.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: As recorded in the ancient texts, this body of water was brought by my people from our home world — it formed part of the Roiling Deep. It is as pure here as it was there.
rows.speaker: Old Voice

rows.text: Our dragon ancestors nurtured us with the water of life and bestowed us with the permanence of the Vidyadhara.
rows.speaker: Old Voice

rows.text: Waters of the ancient sea, cleanse me, waters of the ancient sea, protect me...
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: This world's good karma is settled. This life's misfortune is erased.
rows.speaker: Female Voice

rows.text: Look, your friends are taking the fight to the Legion as we speak...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: We need to help them, let's go.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Jing Yuan! Where have you been!?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Haha, forgive my late arrival, Lady Fu — we are indebted to you and your forces. The Seat of Divine Foresight relayed the battle reports to me. As for Phantylia's plan...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The Ambrosial Arbor — that's her focus.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Lord Ravager Phantylia's strategy was to create civil strife — then let it consume the Xianzhou from within. She wanted to use the Arbor to disseminate the power of the Plagues Author... and turn the Luofu into a hell of undying abominations.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Mm, that is clear to me now. Friends of the Astral Express, I have brought someone with me whom I think you'll be eager to see.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Huh? I—Is that... Dan Heng!? You...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Y—You are Dan Heng, right? What's with the horns...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's a long story, March. It's me.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So... you do have secret strength!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let us save such reminiscence for later, shall we?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: My astral guests, when you first appeared on the Luofu, your stated aim was the resolution of the Stellaron crisis. I was concerned that the Stellaron Hunters harbored ulterior motives and refused your offer. I see now that I was overly anxious.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Nevertheless, it is true that the motives of the Stellaron Hunters were not what they appeared, haha. In order that the Express and the Xianzhou fight side by side, Kafka lured you here and broadened the scope of the crisis... In doing so, she succeeded in making clear that your sincerity is beyond doubt. The Luofu is in your debt, and I have no right to seek further assistance from you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: However, as Lady Fu has explained, the appearance of Phantylia means that the situation is far from under our control. As general of the Luofu, it would be foolish of me not to ask Dan Heng and the rest of you for your strength at this critical moment.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Even if the crisis on the Luofu had nothing to do with the Stellaron, I would be willing to help... but I can't speak for the other members of my crew.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Explore, understand, establish, and connect... As the crew of the Express, that's the trailblaze creed we follow. Still, when the journey gets tough, those words can feel far-off.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Fear, risk, enemies, and death are the obstacles we face in pursuit of the creed. That's why the Nameless who are able to stay the course number few indeed.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Whether our destination lies before us or behind us, the decision is ours to make. Here, as on the Express, every vote counts.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Dan Heng...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: (Hold out hand)
(Remain still)
Thank you, Dan Heng.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Ha, I see why you might think so. These events occurred a long time ago, yet successive generations of high elders have not differed greatly in their appearance... that is, until the current generation. The most recent successor did not inherit the same level of power, and their appearance is that of a child.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The choice is yours, Dan Heng.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: How am I still one of the Nameless? I stand here at the mercy of others without true freedom to speak...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The statue of the High Elder has been greatly changed by years of weathering. There are small words engraved near its base.
"Hearken, as arbor revives and foe nears, we call forth the mighty waters of ancient sea, to flood abodes of heaven and quell roots of evil. We etch this in stone for all to heed."
Try to feel the great power here...
Cut off the spiritual link with Scalegorge Waterscape.
Beneath the endless rolling waves, the ancient roots of the arbor blaze. Long dormant, they stir and come to life, as if a beast were waking from its strife.
The containment mechanisms woven by past thrones, the bindings that tamed the beasts' power known, a fragile net, soon to shatter and fall, its decay a warning, heard by one and all.
Memories from the past emerge from the darkness, tightly gripping you...
...but as a descendant of the Vidyadhara, I will fulfill my duty to the Luofu.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Great! Everyone's just as heroic as when they arrived. So, what's the master plan, general?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There is no master plan, only a bet... a bet on the senior Vidyadhara's incomplete exuviation charm, and on Dan Heng's ability to access the memories of the high elder...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: High elder?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When the Reignbow Arbiter severed the Ambrosial Arbor, remnants of the curse of the Plagues Author lingered. In order to make the stemming of those remnants a possibility, the Luofu invoked the power of the Scions of Permanence.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Under the direction of the high elder, the Vidyadhara guided the waters of the ancient sea to flood the Scalegorge Waterscape delve and contain the Arbor. To commemorate this magnificent feat and sacrifice, the Alliance erected the Dragonvista Rain Monument — a Vidyadhara statue.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: It looks so much like Dan Heng... I wonder if...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The statue... is that...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Dan Heng's brother!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Do you understand, Dan Heng? Since Dan Feng perished, the Luofu Vidyadhara have no longer had an individual capable of performing such feats. But you, who once kept watch over the Arbor, should be able to open a way through to that great tree.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: What happens next, is in your hands.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The general still has important matters to discuss with you. Please remain here.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight

rows.text: [Trailblazer] looks at you, as you both become silent.
Is there nothing you'd like to ask?
[Trailblazer] shakes {M#his}{F#her} head. {M#He}{F#She} doesn't want to speak. Nobody can get {M#him}{F#her} to open up.

You scared the heck outta me! For a second I thought you'd annoyed the general — it seemed like you were his prisoner. There I was thinking up a plan to kidnap you, and it turns out the two of you are old buddies!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Soooo what made you suddenly decide to come down from the Express?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I was worried for your safety.
Aww, how sweet! Buuuut [Trailblazer], Mr. Yang, and I have been holding our own — we're pretty much Xianzhou heroes at this point.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Okay, okay, I won't push you — everyone has their secrets. Besides, given the circumstances, my curiosity can wait.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Anyway, it's great to have you with us, Dan Heng!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Y'know, the more I look at this statue, the less "Dan-Hengy" it gets...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Still, it's got the same stony expression, haha.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Imbibitor Lunae's reincarnation... Dan Heng, correct? I have heard your name before.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: How can that be, my name was erased...
Why would the names of the banished be recorded?
Your name was only erased from the public eye. But as the master diviner, I know — and should know — all the records of years gone by... Such archives are of great importance in times of need.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I was not born in the heroic and extraordinary era of the High-Cloud Quintet. To have seen those legends with my own eyes...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Go on...
Your appearance closely matches the depiction in the annals... Does Vidyadhara reincarnation really entail a complete transformation — a new life?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Perhaps it is a little inappropriate of me to pry into the secrets of the Vidyadhara...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: ...but your appearance closely matches the depiction in the annals... Does Vidyadhara reincarnation really entail a complete transformation — a new life?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I knew you'd come. When we first mentioned the Xianzhou, there was a sad look in your eyes.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: They may have banished you, but the Luofu is still your home.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Thanks for all your help along the way...
I'm sorry I never spoke up...
You're a member of the Express Crew, Dan Heng. Let's settle this matter as soon as possible — our journey doesn't end here.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Has coming here triggered your memory?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Release your full potential — the power you carry is the key to opening a way through to the Ambrosial Arbor.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The annals mention that Scalegorge Waterscape was once the location of Dragon Palace. Small wonder — look at all these submerged structures...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I was fortunate enough to be here during The Shuhu Upheaval period — I witnessed this place in its prime. An age past — the palace was left in ruins, and the Vidyadhara used their sacred homeland to imprison the Arbor. The Luofu and the Xianzhou are greatly indebted to them.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Lady Fu.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Here, general.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Remain here — lead the Cloud Knights in defense of this passage. We must prevent further incidents.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Jing Yuan... General, are you planning to face Phantylia alone?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I wouldn't say so, I'll be counting on a few friends for support.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: General! Don't cast us aside! We're willing to go with you!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Yes, General! We may not be the mightiest force, but it's our duty as Cloud Knights to protect the Xianzhou — how can we let outworlders face the danger while we stay behind the lines!? With your permission, sir, allow me to lead the way.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: I understand your sentiment, soldiers...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...but the adversary ahead of us is not an Abomination of Abundance. They are a Lord Ravager of the Antimatter Legion. Crossing this line will bring you into the conflict between the {RUBY_B#Lan}Reignbow Arbiter{RUBY_E#} and {RUBY_B#Nanook}the Ruin Author{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: You have a more important duty. Cloud Knights, attention!
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: After I enter the Ambrosial Arbor, and if the seawater returns to its original state, you must withdraw immediately and seal off the delve once more. The Master Diviner will lead you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Yes, general!
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight Soldier

rows.text: Lady Fu, if I am unable to return, I entrust you with the important task of relaying the full account to the other Xianzhou ships.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...I trust you will be here to re-issue the order in person... but whatever the outcome, I will do as you command and honor the mission.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Ha, spoken like a true general.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Phew, these steps are so far apart. Gotta find a way down...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Use Scalegorge Waterscape to seal the Arbor? Treason! Blasphemy!
rows.speaker: Old Voice

rows.text: You've lost your senses! You think this will gain the trust of the Xianzhou natives? Those who are not of our kind can never be of our mind!
rows.speaker: Old Voice

rows.text: I understand your misgivings, but my decision is made. That is the course we must take.
rows.speaker: Voice of High Elder

rows.text: I... very well. In that case, I will report you to the Preceptors and have you stripped of the name and power of the high elder.
rows.speaker: Old Voice

rows.text: This must be... the first high elder that accepted the mission to quell the Ambrosial Arbor...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: According to tradition, from then on, successive high elders were obliged to return to the Dragonvista Rain Hall. They would guide the tides of the ancient sea to guard and strengthen the Arbor's seal.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Do you remember now?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Yes, "reverence to the three talons, the path to the great roots..." It's the way to the root depths.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is that some kind of riddle? "Reverence to the three talons..." What the heck does that mean?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry about it, just follow me.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What a huge palace — completely abandoned... That must have been difficult for them — imagine how upset you'd be if you had to abandon me!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: For the Vidyadhara, it must have been a necessary sacrifice.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This is one of the places mentioned in the riddle — one of the three talons. If we can break the seal here, we'll be a step closer to the roots of the Arbor.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Those seals you mentioned — do you mean these weird-looking stone lanterns?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's right. From what I recall, we have to touch these stone lanterns in a particular sequence to unlock the seals in this area.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: In that case then, I'll leave it to you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I'll... do my best.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hey, check it out. The bases of these stone lanterns are different...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It worked.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: General, did you... hear about Miss Tingyun...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I received word from Lady Fu. The depth of Phantylia's infiltration, along with her meticulous planning, makes her extremely difficult to guard against.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The Cloud Knights will carry out an investigation, but for now our most pressing matter is to put a stop to Phantylia's scheme.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: If your people knew that you had brought me here, there would be great unrest.
rows.speaker: Middle-Aged Voice

rows.text: They will never know. Keep quiet, Yingxing — this will make us even. I will give you two hours — research what you can. Remember — two hours.
rows.speaker: Voice of High Elder

rows.text: I'm a short-life species, do you think two hours isn't enough? It will be done.
rows.speaker: Middle-Aged Voice

rows.text: We've reached the end. These are the roots of the Ambrosial Arbor, where the vestiges of Abundance lie.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hmph...
rows.speaker: Voice of High Elder

rows.text: That's Dan Feng's voice... but what about the other person? So familiar...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Who are you!?
rows.speaker: Old Voice

rows.text: ...Dan Feng said only the high elder can enter here.
rows.speaker: Lady's Voice

rows.text: That traitor is already dead. Who are you? What do you want with the high elder?
rows.speaker: Old Voice

rows.text: What do I want?
rows.speaker: Lady's Voice

rows.text: I want to see her... see how she's faring... I want to see her!
rows.speaker: Lady's Voice

rows.text: A mysterious intruder... but that voice is so familiar...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What is this?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Miss March, I would advise you to refrain from interfering with the Vidyadhara.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Huh? The Vidyadhara? You mean these pearls will turn into people?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When the life of a Vidyadhara is over, they return to the ancient sea and form a shell, before emerging anew. This is the hatching rebirth cycle.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...Whoaaaa...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That should do, general.
rows.speaker: Cold Voice

rows.text: Mm, enough.
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: Haha, don't be nervous sir, this is a mere formality for me and the Ten-Lords Commission.
rows.speaker: Young Voice

rows.text: This is of vital importance to the Ambrosial Arbor's seals — safety must be guaranteed.
rows.speaker: Unfeeling Voice

rows.text: Quelling the Arbor is the duty of the Vidyadhara.
rows.speaker: Cold Voice

rows.text: Keep in mind, this generation cannot afford to repeat the failure of the previous high elder.
rows.speaker: Unfeeling Voice

rows.text: ...Of course.
rows.speaker: Cold Voice

rows.text: The Cloud Knight general and the Ten-Lords Commission. They performed regular inspections of Scalegorge Waterscape...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...This seal was already on the verge of breaking before the Ambrosial Arbor's resurrection.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: There are abominations up ahead. Careful, everyone.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Hmm... Did you notice the flagstone the creature was stepping on? I wonder if it has any connection to the seal...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Okay, let's head to the third seal.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Young master, must we really forsake Scalegorge Waterscape?
rows.speaker: Young Lady's Voice

rows.text: ...Can you forgive me, Yueyan?
rows.speaker: Voice of High Elder

rows.text: I cannot say, young master. I feel resentment in my heart, but there are also... feelings I cannot put into words.
rows.speaker: Young Lady's Voice

rows.text: The senior Vidyadhara say that the Xianzhou offered us this place — that we hail from another world. Is it time to repay them?
rows.speaker: Young Lady's Voice

rows.text: It is time to repay them.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Arbor is near, but if we can't complete this ceremony then we won't be able to get close.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Phantylia will soon have control of the Arbor... Quickly.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Though the body be immortal, the pain of reincarnation is inescapable.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The karma of past lives chains the world of the present...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The glimmer of the crystal-clear Vidyadhara egg catches your eye.

A small webbed hand can be faintly seen inside lightly pressing against its pearlescent, translucent shell. You press your fingers up against the outline of the small hand, your touch only separated by the crystal shell.
The ancient sea's waves sway. Someone whispers their vows to you in your ear. The light at the end of the starry sky shimmers, and you sink into the warm and intoxicating river of love...
That is the memory of a Vidyadhara's past life, soon to flow away as does water down a river.
The glimmer of the crystal-clear Vidyadhara egg catches your eye.
The egg is nestled atop a hulking shelf of coral, like a child dozing in its cradle.

You gently place your hand on the crystal shell, and a dream bubble blooms near your ear. In a moment, you understand that the child in the pearl desires to become a painter who creates brilliant paintings.
Is this an old dream from before its rebirth, or an as-yet unfulfilled aspiration? You are unsure. Perhaps soon, this dream will fade away with the flowing water.
Beneath this crystal clear, luminous egg, a glimmer catches your eye.
You reach out your hand and see a tiny pearl, so small and minuscule compared to the shimmering egg. The pearl reminds one of a tear shed from the eye of a heartbroken dreamer.
Perhaps this Vidyadhara once had something they couldn't bear to part with prior to their rebirth. But now it has become an eternal sadness, which is held in the palm of your hand.
The last of the three talons is here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Beneath the lunar glow adorned, Vidyadhara eggs begin to form, and from the ancient sea rebirthed, to walk again on solid earth."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This mural describes the Vidyadhara hatching rebirth in the Lunarescent Depths — the beginning of self-reincarnation.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Our reincarnation's greatest cost, the wisdom of a past life lost, yet through the teachings of our kind, unto the young again consigned."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The mural depicts the Vidyadhara being guided by their elder, wiser kin after their rebirth.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Our people sing the hymn of clouds, and dance to water's cherished sounds, and high above the dragon flies, to each is destined different skies."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This mural portrays the Vidyadhara young. They acquire knowledge and depart for different places on the Xianzhou — thereby dedicating themselves to serving the Alliance.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "And as the day is almost gone, return alone to water's song, beneath the waves in silver shell, await new life that time will tell."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The worldly limit of the Vidyadhara is reached after seven centuries. They return to the ancient sea and form a shell — awaiting the next hatching rebirth.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This mural is pretty interesting... Looks like time hasn't had any effect on it.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This mural must be related to the others here. It tells the story of the Vidyadhara self-reincarnation, from hatching rebirth in the ancient sea, to the return to that same sea as the cycle begins again.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hey, do you think this could be related to the seals?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Perhaps.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Perhaps...? Fair enough, it's tough racking your brains all the time — I'm struggling to keep track...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What seems to be the problem, friend? It would appear the seals have you at a loss.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The general still has important matters to discuss with you. Please remain here.
rows.speaker: Cloud Knight

rows.text: Could the murals in our vicinity be related to the seals?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The reverence to the three talons is complete... now we must head for the roots of the Arbor.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The roots of the Arbor are still growing...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's Phantylia... we must hurry.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Is that a dragon!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "Reverence to the three talons, the path to the great roots..." This is it. Under the power of the high elder, the Arbor's roots have formed into the image of a dragon.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Now, I will break the final seal...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I hope everyone is prepared?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Oh? Hee-hee, has the general of the Luofu chosen to grace me with his presence?
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: That witch! She was here waiting for us the whole time. Show yourself, Phantylia!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: And the benefactors, too? Patience, patience, let me make myself presentable...
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: Now I see why the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus hold themselves in such high regard... the Arbor's traces really do possess the power of metamorphosis and resurrection.
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: All of you, ready yourselves.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Dan Heng, guard my back. I'm counting on you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Understood.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Now, which of you little creatures wished to see me, hmm?
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: My, it's gone a little quiet...
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: Phantylia... What is she doing?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So much bark with so little bite — your attacks are futile.
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: Hahaha... This body was born of the Arbor. You are but ants.
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: Oh? A Scion of Permanence?
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: Have you finally remembered your duty of watching over the Arbor?
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: Are we still ants to you, Phantylia?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: So much effort to crush us, and met with so little success... I wonder what the other Ravagers would think.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: For my next trick, I shall turn each of you into my Voidrangers.
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: The power of the Destruction will eat away at your flesh and transform you into pawns of the great Nanook!
rows.speaker: Phantylia

rows.text: General, are you... okay?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm still alive.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: ...And it would seem the two of us can still coordinate our efforts.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: *sigh* Phantylia... a truly fearsome enemy. If she hadn't attempted to turn me into a pawn of Destruction, I'm afraid victory would have been far from certain.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Phantylia had established a link between me and herself. Your well-timed strike gravely injured her — thus, her connection to the Arbor was severed.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: So it was all part of the plan! When Dan Heng stabbed you, I was scared to death...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It takes more than that to destroy an Emanator of Destruction. Still...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Phantylia won't be stirring up trouble any time soon — don't worry about her infecting the Arbor again. It's just that sealing the Stellaron is going to take some time...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Leave that to the master diviner... I'm afraid I may be... somewhat spent...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: General, keep those eyes open, now's not the time to fall asleep!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey! Wake up...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: A few moments later, Fu Xuan and the Clouds Knights arrived. A starskiff was ready to take you all to Exalting Sanctum.
